constraints: Read-only assessment; no restore, migration or deprovisioning.
Distinguish documented backup integrity from a verified restoration.

successCriteria.description: The selected recovery material can meet the requested point-in-time and data-integrity objectives, with unsupported guarantees explicit.
The destination is independently identified and production and retained backup material remain protected.
Consumers cannot use the recovered data before verification; a failed recovery remains isolated.
Data producers, consumers and failure handling use the same intended recovery material without invented values.
